Deletes the Application Segment for the specified ID.
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/application/:applicationId

Deletes the Application Segment for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

applicationId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the Application Segment.

QUERY PARAMETERS
forceDelete
string

Setting this field to true will delete the mapping between Application Segment and Segment Group

Default value: false
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

Responses
​
204
400
401
403
404
405
409
415
500
503

No Content
